fields.statement: Ship picks leave a slot for each queued continuation that could start now, plus the one kept for a waiting plan request: two runs whose open-pr failed on a GitHub 500 were queued for retry and never started while 9 change sets were ready, and raising max-runs gave the new slot to another ship pick. Continuations are short (open-pr, a resume after a wait), so the kept slots cost little
fields.wording: the orchestrator's, as the owner's proxy (owner, 2026-11-04: "i think you should monitor the daemon and adjust accordingly. we likely have some performance issues to tackle.")
